description: This file contains unit tests for exception safety of absl::optional, including constructors, assignment, swap, and emplace operations, specifically testing exception safety guarantees and invariants.

methods.name: ValueThrowsBadOptionalAccess
methods.description: Checks if accessing the value of an optional throws bad_optional_access exception.

methods.name: OptionalInvariants
methods.description: Verifies the invariants of an optional after exception-throwing operations and reset.

methods.name: CheckDisengaged
methods.description: Checks if an optional is disengaged (empty).

methods.name: CheckEngaged
methods.description: Checks if an optional is engaged (contains a value).
